# v2.3.0 — Rate limit handling & full API coverage

## Highlights

### 🚦 Rate limit handling
Rate-limited requests now retry automatically after the wait the API asks for, when that wait is about a minute or less. Longer waits fail straight away with a clear error that says how long to wait.
With **Continue On Fail**, the error item includes `retryAt`, so a workflow can branch on it or pause with a Wait node.
→ [Limits per plan](https://docs.fireflies.ai/fundamentals/limits)

### ✨ Full API coverage
Every query and mutation in the Fireflies public API is now available in n8n.

| Resource | New |
|---|---|
| **Meeting** | Pause/Resume Recording · Live Action Items · Live Soundbites · filters on Active Meetings |
| **User** | Get by ID · Add to Group · Remove From Group |
| **Audio** | Upload File (direct binary upload) · meeting date on Upload Audio |
| **Transcript** | Password-protected sharing · richer Get List fields · `notes` in summaries |
| **AskFred** | Suggested follow-up questions |
| **Audit Event** · **Rule Execution** | New resources, with Return All pagination |

## 🐛 Fixes
- **Upload Audio**: attendees and download authentication are now sent in the format the API accepts. Before, the API rejected both.
- **Create Bite**: media type is now a dropdown.

## 🧪 Quality
- A test suite now runs on every pull request.
- Every query is checked against the live API schema.
